title: Troubleshooting and Observability

header.html: Debug application code and service integration issues (4.1.1); interpret metrics, logs and traces (4.1.2); query logs (4.1.3); troubleshoot deployment failures with output logs (4.1.4); use AWS AI tools to analyze errors (4.1.5); implement effective logging, custom metrics, notification alerts, tracing and health monitoring (4.2.1 to 4.2.5)
the official AWS Developer Associate (DVA-C03) exam guide, Tasks 4.1 and 4.2

html:
1The three pillars

Pillar Service Answers
Logs Amazon CloudWatch Logs What happened?
Metrics Amazon CloudWatch metrics and alarms How is it performing?
Traces AWS X-Ray Where is the time or the failure across services?

AWS CloudTrail records API calls (who did what), a different job: auditing.

2CloudWatch Logs

Concept Meaning
Log group / log stream A group per application; a stream per source (for example per Lambda instance)
Retention Set it; default is never expire
Logs Insights Query language to search and aggregate logs
Metric filter Turn log patterns into a metric (for example, count ERROR)
Structured logging Log JSON with fields (request ID, user, action) so queries are easy
Exam tip

. "Find the slowest requests in the logs" = CloudWatch Logs Insights. "Alarm on the number of errors in logs" = metric filter plus alarm.

3Metrics, alarms and notifications

Feature Meaning
Custom metrics Your code emits values with PutMetricData or Embedded Metric Format (EMF) logs
Alarm Watches a metric and changes state; can notify through SNS or trigger actions
Notifications SNS email or messages for quota limits or deployment completions (via EventBridge rules)
Health checks Load balancer target health checks; container liveness and readiness probes (EKS)

4Tracing with AWS X-Ray

Concept Meaning
Trace The path of one request through services
Segment / subsegment A unit of work in a service; subsegments for downstream calls
Annotations Indexed key-value pairs you can filter and search by
Metadata Extra data not indexed
Sampling Trace a fraction of requests to control cost
Enable Turn on active tracing for Lambda or API Gateway; use the X-Ray SDK or daemon elsewhere
Exam tip

. Annotations are searchable; metadata is not. "Find which downstream call is slow" = X-Ray service map and traces.

5Root cause analysis

Symptom Likely direction
HTTP 4xx Client request problem: validation, auth, throttling (429)
HTTP 5xx / 502 / 504 Backend error, bad response, or timeout (504 gateway timeout)
Lambda timeout Raise timeout or optimize; check downstream latency
Lambda throttled Concurrency limit reached
Deployment failure Read CloudFormation stack events and CodeDeploy/CodeBuild output logs
Access denied Check the role policy, resource policy and KMS key policy

AWS AI tools can analyze errors and suggest fixes [Verify live]; verify the suggestion before applying it.

Exam tip

. A 5xx points to the backend, a 4xx to the request, a 504 to a timeout. Read the status code before choosing the fix.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A team wants to know which downstream service adds the most latency to a request. What should they use?

  • AAWS X-Ray traces
  • BAWS KMS
  • CAmazon S3 Lifecycle
  • DAmazon Route 53
Show the answer

Answer: A. X-Ray shows the path and timing of a request across services.

S2A team wants an alarm when the word "ERROR" appears more than ten times a minute in logs. What should they create?

  • AA DLQ
  • BA metric filter and a CloudWatch alarm
  • CA usage plan
  • DA KMS key
Show the answer

Answer: B. A metric filter turns log patterns into a metric to alarm on.

S3Which X-Ray feature lets a developer search traces by customer ID?

  • AMetadata
  • BSampling rate
  • CSegment name only
  • DAnnotations
Show the answer

Answer: D. Annotations are indexed and searchable.

S4Logs are unstructured text and hard to query. What is the best improvement?

  • AShorter log retention
  • BMore log groups with random names
  • CLogging nothing
  • DStructured JSON logging with consistent fields
Show the answer

Answer: D. Structured logs are easy to filter and aggregate.

S5A CloudFormation deployment failed. Where should the developer look first?

  • AThe S3 bucket policy
  • BStack events
  • CThe DynamoDB item
  • DRoute 53 records
Show the answer

Answer: B. Stack events show which resource failed and why.

S6A function returns HTTP 504 through API Gateway. What is the likely cause?

  • AThe backend took longer than the integration timeout
  • BThe request was missing a field
  • CThe user lacked MFA
  • DThe table used on-demand mode
Show the answer

Answer: A. 504 means a gateway timeout from a slow backend.

6.2 Recall questions

R1Name the three pillars of observability.

Show the answer

Logs, metrics and traces.

R2Which service records API activity?

Show the answer

AWS CloudTrail.

R3What does Logs Insights do?

Show the answer

Queries and aggregates CloudWatch Logs.

R4What is the difference between X-Ray annotations and metadata?

Show the answer

Annotations are indexed and searchable; metadata is not.

R5What emits custom metrics from code?

Show the answer

PutMetricData or Embedded Metric Format logs.

R6What does HTTP 429 mean?

Show the answer

Too many requests (throttling); retry with backoff.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Pillars logs (CloudWatch Logs), metrics (CloudWatch), traces (X-Ray); CloudTrail audits
Logs groups and streams, retention, Insights, metric filters, structured JSON
X-Ray traces, segments, annotations (searchable), metadata, sampling
Alerts alarms, SNS, EventBridge, health checks
Errors 4xx client, 5xx backend, 504 timeout, 429 throttle
